answer: Picture identities as walnuts: each agent must crack open a refundable stake-bond before trading, and that deposit is slashed on misbehavior. A sybil attacker cannot climb the trust ridge for free, because every fake persona demands its own locked capital plus a cooldown. Minting a thousand throwaway agents then costs a thousand bonds, not one, so forgery scales like writing a fresh sonnet per mask rather than photocopying a single face.
